episodes.title: Solving Problems
episodes.description: Work through mathematical problems step by step and consider what it means to solve an equation.

episodes.title: Word Problems
episodes.description: Use word problems to connect mathematical equations with visual thinking and everyday situations.

episodes.title: Negative Numbers and Arithmetic
episodes.description: Explore the history and practical uses of negative numbers.

episodes.description: Learn four key rules for manipulating fractions.

episodes.title: Exponents and Scientific Notation
episodes.description: Explore negative and fractional exponents alongside familiar powers and scientific notation.

episodes.title: Logarithms and Exponents
episodes.description: In this episode of Study Hall: Algebra, James demystifies logarithms!

episodes.title: Polynomials and Imaginary Numbers
episodes.description: Use the box method to multiply and factor polynomials.

episodes.title: Quadratic Equations
episodes.description: Understand the quadratic equation and ways to make working with it more manageable.

episodes.title: Zero to Infinity
episodes.description: Explore the history and special properties of zero, including why division by zero causes problems.
